tasks.description: Single-writer owner of all new config surface: add inventory-enable flag, dormancy age + token thresholds with deadband/hysteresis margin, probe-staleness window, and post_floor calibration window with a static 70000 fallback, to config.json and any default/accessor wiring in config_lib.py. Choose sensible default values and key names per spec §10; downstream tasks only READ these. Do not touch policy.py/pi_bridge.py.

Hoist the per-item primitives that STILL LIVE in turn_profile.py — the per-item flag engine (_compute_flags, turn_profile.py:233) and the tool-breakdown family — into pi_session_lib.py as the neutral home, then refactor turn_profile.py to import them from there. NOTE active_path/analyze_active_prefix ALREADY live in pi_session_lib.py (lines 241/257) — do not re-hoist them; just confirm they're importable by context_inventory. Decide the module boundary so there is NO import cycle (context_inventory and turn_profile both depend on pi_session_lib, never the reverse). Preserve turn_profile public behavior byte-for-byte.

Build context_inventory.py emitting the ContextInventory model per spec §4. (a) DYNAMIC: a ContextItem ledger with dormant/redundant/reclaimable flags plus a ReclaimEstimate with deterministic ordered ranking; dormancy/redundancy/reclaimability classification reads age/token thresholds from config; build only on the hoisted pi_session_lib primitives (no import cycle). (b) FULL FloorBreakdown (the reviewer-flagged gap): LIVE-measure context_files + skills_meta (chars/4 of injected markdown); READ tools_system from floor-probe.json under statedir.state_root('pi') if present (the per_package map the floor-probe subsystem writes) — RUNTIME read with a graceful NO-PROBE FALLBACK to a single honest 'tools+system (fixed)' bucket (no build-time dep on the probe task); true_residual = total − everything attributed. (c) STANDALONE --inventory REPORT (spec §5/§11): add a main()/CLI in context_inventory.py plus a src/context_inventory.py path-shim that builds the inventory over the active prefix and prints a content-free report (token counts + category/tool/package names only), CONSUMING ReclaimEstimate.ranking verbatim — never re-rank/recompute. Cover the report OUTPUT (not just argparse) with a unit test in test_context_inventory.py that runs the report over a fixture session (tests/fixtures/pi/*.jsonl) and asserts a token-count line renders — the --help smoke alone is insufficient (argparse short-circuits before report logic). (d) PUBLISH THE EXPLICIT API CONTRACT here (consumers T4/T5/T8 cannot edit this file, so it must be pinned by the producer): a `build_inventory(active_prefix, total_tokens, window, *, include_probe=True)` entry returning a ContextInventory dataclass with STABLE named fields — floor.{context_files,skills_meta,tools_system,true_residual}, dynamic[].{kind,tool_name,tokens,age_turns,dormant,redundant,reclaimable}, dynamic_dormant_tokens, reclaim.{reclaimable_now,post_floor_estimate,ranking} — PLUS a decision-safe path (`decision_floor_terms(...)` or `include_probe=False`) returning live base+skills WITHOUT ever opening floor-probe.json, so the decision consumer (T8) cannot read the readout-only probe (T9's boundary; floor-probe.json is read ONLY when include_probe=True). (e) NEVER-RAISE FALLBACK (spec §8) MUST BE SELF-CONTAINED: on internal failure return a degraded inventory computed from `total` alone and MUST NOT call transcript_lib.context_composition() — T4 turns that into an adapter over THIS module, so calling it would infinitely recurse.

Refactor transcript_lib.context_composition() into a thin ADAPTER over the new ContextInventory model, AND make it the single PRODUCER of the new inventory fields in the comp dict that readout (T6/T7) consumes — emit the dynamic per-item ledger summary, the dormant-tokens rollup, and the floor decomposition (context_files/skills_meta/tools_system/true_residual + per-package breakdown when probe data exists) as NEW keys ADDED ALONGSIDE the existing ones. 'Parity' means the EXISTING 55cdfef keys/values remain byte-identical (golden-baseline fixture of current main output, assert exact reproduction — NOT a vacuous new-vs-new self-comparison); the new keys are additive on top. The model→comp-dict projection key names defined here are the contract T6 renders against. PRESERVE the current context_composition() body as a private `_legacy_composition()` helper BEFORE adapting; the public adapter falls back to `_legacy_composition()` (NOT back into the inventory) when build_inventory raises/returns degraded — this breaks the spec §8 recursion path (the inventory never calls context_composition; the adapter's fallback is its own frozen legacy, never re-entering the inventory).

Register the new dormant_output boundary signal in transcript_lib.active_signals() as a medium-tier ADDITIVE signal that NEVER suppresses stale_output, computed from ContextInventory dynamic_dormant_tokens vs the config threshold with deadband/hysteresis. PERSIST the deadband prior on/off state in a small JSON under statedir.state_root('pi') (import statedir as a read-only path helper — do NOT edit statedir.py; this keeps the task within transcript_lib.py + its test), read/written within the dormant_output computation so hysteresis survives across evaluate calls. Wire the signal through observe_only(), the signal table, and build_context_state so it appears in logged signals + contextState; the monitor/backtester pick it up automatically via the dynamic active_signals()/observe_only() consumption in pi_bridge. Same file as the composition adapter, so serialized after it.

Extend policy.composition_detail_lines() to render the ContextInventory per-item dynamic ledger and dormant breakdown surfaced additively in the context_composition() comp dict by inventory-core: dynamic per-item highlights (kind/tool_name/tokens/age_turns) and a dormant-tokens rollup line, plus the floor decomposition (context_files, skills_meta, per-package tool-schema breakdown labeled 'measured <date>' (the date rendered from floor-probe.json's frozen `measured_at` key) when probe data exists, else the honest single 'tools+system (fixed)' bucket, and true_residual). CONSUME the model's figures verbatim — never re-rank, never recompute reclaim or dormancy. Content-free: token counts and category/tool/package names only, reconciled to the authoritative total. Add assertion-bearing tests in tests/test_policy.py driving composition_detail_lines from a fixture comp dict that includes the new inventory fields (assert dormant rollup line and per-item highlights render; assert the no-probe fallback bucket), and assert back-compat when the inventory fields are absent (today's 55cdfef output unchanged).

Design and add a reducible-floor advisory renderer in policy.py that surfaces ReclaimEstimate.ranking [(bucket, tokens, reducible_by)] from inventory-core as user-actionable guidance, choosing the wording/format for lines like 'unload pi-subagents ~= 11k' and '--exclude-tools context-mode admin tools ~= 8k'. Decide thresholds for which ranking buckets are worth surfacing and how many to show, and frame it so the user understands /compact cannot unload packages (the lever is not loading them). CONSUME ranking and reclaim figures from the model verbatim — never re-rank, never recompute. Content-free: token counts and bucket/package names only. Add tests in tests/test_policy.py asserting the advisory renders the ranking order unchanged from a fixture ReclaimEstimate, formats the reducible-floor figure, and returns empty when no ranking/reclaim data is present.

Wire the v1 decision-consumer corrections into pi_bridge.py ONLY (spec §6 as corrected by cross-vendor review). DESIGN the config-aware post_floor and DECIDE the soft-vs-hard suppression boundary: (6.1) replace the static 70000 post_floor in cmd_evaluate with post_floor = live_fixed_floor (base + persistent skills for THIS session, obtained from inventory-core's context_inventory via its DECISION-SAFE entry decision_floor_terms()/include_probe=False — base = total − measured, and this path NEVER opens floor-probe.json, preserving the T9 readout-only boundary) + summary_term, where summary_term is the telemetry MEDIAN of historical post_total−(base+skills); read that history back by parsing the raw events.jsonl under statedir.state_root()/stats (do NOT edit stats.py — no read API exists, raw-log read is the intended path); fall back to static 70000 only when no telemetry history exists. To make that median buildable, PERSIST post_total, base, skills on the REINJECT event in cmd_reinject (~src/autocompactor/pi_bridge.py:330-390, where post-compaction state exists — NOT precompact) via the schema-free log_event(). GUARD CORRECTION (the cross-vendor-fought line): today `if est_reclaim < min_savings: recommend = False` blanket-suppresses; change it so min_savings suppresses ONLY the opportunistic soft path (occupancy < hard) and is NEVER applied at/above the hard line — a hard-line compaction always proceeds. (6.2) CONSUME the dormant_output signal that inventory-core registers as a non-observe entry in transcript_lib.active_signals(): it already flows through the existing sig_pairs->gating computation in cmd_evaluate and OR-combines additively with stale_output with no further code change — do NOT invent a local-only gate and do NOT edit transcript_lib; the dormant deadband/hysteresis lives in inventory-core, not here. FALLBACK swaps INPUTS only, never the policy formula (spec §8): on inventory failure use degraded inputs (static post_floor + aggregate stale_output) but STILL run the corrected rule — the hard line is never gated by min_savings even on the fallback path — and emit a visible telemetry event. Proof obligations (spec §9): hard-line fires with estimated savings < min_savings; no-telemetry -> 70000 fallback; post_floor tracks a changed live base; dormant_output additive-OR never suppresses a stale_output firing; visible-fallback (forced inventory error -> static inputs + corrected formula still recommends at hard); and the decision path does NOT read floor-probe.json (assert cmd_evaluate never opens the probe artifact — the readout-only boundary, complementing T9's producer-side assertion).

Add a readout-only PER-PACKAGE floor probe to nightly_eval.py using the ISOLATION-SPAWN method (spec §7 + §3 — the reviewer-flagged mis-coverage: do NOT reconstruct from events.jsonl; that categorically cannot decompose per-package cost). Tool schemas are generated from zod AT LOAD and are not measurable from on-disk source, so the probe must SPAWN isolated pi instances toggling layers — the 2026-06-09 investigation's method: a baseline `pi -p --no-extensions` vs full, and per-package isolation via a temp PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR — and diff first-request token counts to attribute per-package tool-schema cost. Write floor-probe.json under statedir.state_root('pi') with this FROZEN schema (all consumers — inventory-core.model tools_system read, T10 freshness, T6 label — MUST use these exact keys): {"per_package": {name: tokens}, "measured_at": <ISO-8601 UTC string>, "pi_version": <str>, "staleness_budget": <seconds int>}. OBSERVATIONAL ONLY: must NOT feed any decision path in v1 (the live decision uses the residual base, never the probe) — the test asserts no decision/policy module reads floor-probe.json. Do NOT edit statedir.py (read-only path helper). Writes floor-probe.json only (not events.jsonl); disjoint from decision's reinject event fields. Consumes the probe-staleness config key from inventory-core for the staleness_budget. The per_package map is the producer for inventory-core.model's tools_system read and the readout reducible-floor advisory.

Surface floor-probe freshness/staleness in install_pi.py do_status(): read floor-probe.json from statedir.state_root('pi'), compare its `measured_at` (ISO-8601, the frozen T9 key) against the probe-staleness config key (defined by inventory-core) and print a fresh/stale/missing line in the --status health block. Read-only consumer of the artifact written by floor-probe.nightly-probe; touches only install_pi.py so it stays file-disjoint from the probe writer.
verify_commands: AUTOCOMPACTOR_STATE_DIR=$(mktemp -d) PYTHONPATH=src python3 src/autocompactor/install_pi.py --status | grep -iq probe
